usd_observations.product: 10% Air / 18% Oil RC aviation nitro fuel, quart cans, case of 12
usd_observations.price_basis: Seller lists one case of 12 x 1-quart cans for USD 117.99, with a unit price of USD 9.83 per quart can; freight and hazardous-material charges were not captured in the displayed product price.
usd_observations.availability: 7 cases listed in stock on 2026-10-16: 5 at Edwards, Illinois and 2 at Las Vegas, Nevada. Destination shipping was not verified.
usd_observations.quantity: One 12-can case; each can contains 1 US quart. Product description states the 18% oil package is 80% multiviscosity synthetic and 20% castor.
usd_observations.evidence_quality: Direct seller-page fetch on 2026-10-16 confirmed product, SKU, case count, USD 117.99 case price, USD 9.83 per-can price, stock by warehouse, fuel blend title, and oil-package description. The official O.S. MAX-50SX/40/46/61/91 FX instruction manual states 5-20% nitromethane is preferable and fuel must contain at least 18% lubricant by volume; the Ugly Stik inventory names an O.S. MAX-61FX.

candidate_groups.basis: The VP product's 10% nitromethane/18% total oil falls within the referenced MAX-61FX manual guidance. A volume-share arithmetic reference is USD 1.56 for the modeled 150mL contents: USD 9.83/quart x 150mL / 946.352946mL per US quart.
candidate_groups.limitations: The authored physical row specifies only a methanol/oil/nitro blend, not its percentages or brand. USD 1.56 excludes case-level purchase, freight and hazardous-material charges. This is a formula-compatible price candidate, not evidence of the installed blend or a modeled-physics match; no allocation.

usd_observations.allocation: Unallocated offer. The package is a case of 12 quarts; do not treat USD 117.99 as the cost of onboard 150mL or as an aircraft build total.

official_technical_references.relevant_guidance: For the FX series, the manual says 5-20% nitromethane is preferable and fuel must contain at least 18% lubricant by volume. This establishes an engine-fuel specification boundary only; it does not identify the Ugly Stik's installed blend.

integration_recommendations: Retain all four offers as unallocated candidates. Do not change installed identity, aircraft costing, catalog values, or build completeness from these listings alone.
Keep the Ugly Stik receiver row unresolved in USD: the GBP Overlander quote is electrically exact but its 55g mass differs from the 105g modeled estimate and foreign currency must remain separate.

For the Ugly Stik's 150mL fuel contents, USD 1.56 is only a normalized volume-share reference against the listed per-quart price; the seller package is a 12-quart case and shipping/HazMat costs are unknown. The actual blend composition remains unspecified.

Treat the Gator pack as a current USD price observation for P-51 LiFe capacity/chemistry research only. Its 99g weight, receiver-only description, and unverified ignition and power-board connections do not establish a physical or installed match.
Keep the Extra receiver listing in EUR. The electrical description matches, but modeled weight and pack layout/connector are not verified; do not convert it into a USD economic amount.
